result.brief: 提出以自车轨迹为引导的占用世界模型 ReCast，通过相对自车变换对齐可变形交互，并构建反事实动作忠实性基准，提升分布外轨迹下的预测可靠性。
result.reason: Occupancy world model with action-conditioned future prediction and counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark; main contribution is 3D occupancy world modeling for driving, an application-level world model.
